answer: Deposits are visible in inlet, and reef reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 120 aliases, and each one needs its own funded karst account. A bond of 38% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Each duplicate costs another 110 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
